insert.charts.columnBar.note: U:grid/insert: the Column menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.charts.lineArea.note: U:grid/insert: the Line menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.charts.pieDoughnut.note: U:grid/insert: the Pie menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.charts.scatterBubble.note: U:grid/insert: the Scatter menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.charts.statistic.note: U:grid/insert: the Statistic menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.charts.hierarchy.note: U:grid/insert: the Hierarchy menu is drawn tiles under Excel's group headings; each tile inserts that exact kind (insert.chart {kind}). 3-D, Pie of Pie and the like are not drawn by gridcraft.

insert.tables.pivotTable.note: U:grid/pivot: translated from gridcraft cmd/pivot (insert.pivotTable); From Table/Range opens Excel's Create PivotTable (the table or range, New Worksheet or Existing Worksheet).

insert.tables.recommendedPivotTables.note: U:grid/insert: translated from gridcraft cmd/pivot/charts.rs (`recommended`, `suggestions`): up to five layouts that suit the data (sum by a category, by two, by quarters, two values, count, average) with a preview; OK creates the one picked as a new PivotTable. Blank PivotTable and Change Source Data are Create PivotTable's.

insert.illustrations.icons.note: U:grid/insert: gridcraft's icon library (30 icons, six per row) drawn as tiles; each tile inserts that icon (insert.icons {name}).

insert.illustrations.3dModels.note: U:grid/insert: 3D Models opens .glb or .fbx models and the online stock library; there is no 3-D model renderer here; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.illustrations.smartArt.note: U:grid/insert: SmartArt lives in PowerPoint's presentation engine and has no counterpart in the sheet's drawing layer; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.illustrations.screenshot.note: U:grid/insert: Screenshot captures other windows or a clipped part of the screen through the operating system; the app never captures the screen; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.addins.get.note: U:grid/insert: Get Add-ins needs the Office add-in store, an online service; hidden.

insert.addins.my.note: U:grid/insert: My Add-ins lists store add-ins, which are not run here; hidden.

insert.charts.maps.note: U:grid/insert: Maps (Filled Map) draw from an online mapping service (Bing); no service is used here, so they stay hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.charts.pivotChart.note: U:grid/insert: translated from gridcraft cmd/pivot/charts.rs (`insert_pivot_chart`): a chart of the PivotTable under the selection, rebuilt whenever the report changes and saved with its pivotSource. Without a PivotTable under the selection Excel's Create PivotChart asks for the data and makes a blank PivotTable with its chart.

insert.tours.3dMap.note: U:grid/insert: 3D Maps needs an online mapping service and a 3-D globe renderer; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.filters.slicer.note: U:grid/slicer: translated from gridcraft cmd/slicer.rs (insert.slicer): Excel's Insert Slicers check list of the table's columns; gridcraft's slicers filter tables.

insert.filters.timeline.note: U:grid/insert: Timeline filters a PivotTable by a date field through a drawn timeline; it needs the PivotTable date grouping and a timeline object that gridcraft does not have; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.links.link.recent-items.note: U:grid/insert: Recent Items lists recently used files and pages from the system and browser history, which the app never reads; hidden.

insert.comments.comment.note: U:grid/insert: New Comment starts a threaded comment on the active cell (gridcraft review.newComment {threaded: true}).

insert.text.headerFooter.note: U:grid/insert: gridcraft starts editing the header in Page Layout view; the Page Layout pass supplies it (Page Setup > Header/Footer).

insert.text.wordArt.note: U:grid/insert: not in gridcraft; built after Excel's WordArt gallery (core/grid/lib/wordart.mjs, fifteen styles in the workbook's theme colours): a text box whose letters take the style, "Your text here" to start. Not checked against upstream.

insert.text.signatureLine.note: U:grid/insert: not in gridcraft; Excel's Signature Setup (signer, title, e-mail, instructions, comments, show date) puts a signature line (an X, the line, the signer and title) on the sheet. No digital signature is made. Not checked against upstream.

insert.text.object.note: U:grid/insert: Insert Object embeds OLE objects (other applications' documents); OLE is not run here; hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.symbols.equation.note: U:grid/insert: not in gridcraft; Equation puts a text box holding an equation in Excel's linear form, drawn in the maths font; the gallery draws each one, set as MathML, Excel's built-in equations. Ink Equation reads handwriting and stays hidden. Not checked against upstream.

insert.symbols.equation.insert-new-equat.note: U:grid/insert: an empty equation text box ("Type equation here."); not checked against upstream.

insert.symbols.symbol.note: U:grid/insert: gridcraft's thirty symbols drawn as tiles (insert.symbol {char}); More Symbols… opens the Symbol dialog.

insert.chartOfPie.sourceRef: office:Excel Insert > Charts > Pie of Pie
insert.chartOfPie.summary: Insert a Pie of Pie or Bar of Pie chart.

insert.chartScatterVariant.summary: Insert a smoothed or marker scatter chart.

insert.chartCustomCombo.sourceRef: office:Excel Insert > Charts > Create Custom Combo Chart
insert.chartCustomCombo.summary: Insert a combo chart with a type chosen per series.

dialog.createTable.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Create Table (Where is the data for your table?, My table has headers). gridcraft converts the current region with no dialog; the command takes the same range and header.

dialog.insertLink.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Insert Hyperlink with Existing File or Web Page, Place in This Document and E-mail Address pages, drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/insertLink.tsx. Create New Document is not offered (gridcraft cannot create files from a link).

fields.label: Or select a place in this document:

dialog.insertPicture.title: Insert Picture
dialog.insertPicture.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's This Device picker. Browse… asks the system Open dialog for a PNG or JPEG; Place in Cell or Place over Cells is the menu item that opened it.

dialog.recommendedCharts.note: U:grid/insert: Recommended Charts lists the types insert.chartRecommendations returns with a preview of the chart on the selected data; All Charts lists every type gridcraft draws. Templates, Surface and Map are not in gridcraft.

dialog.symbol.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Symbol dialog (Symbols by subset, Special Characters), drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/symbol.tsx; Insert puts the character at the end of the active cell's text (gridcraft insert.symbol). The font box is left out (cells have one font).

dialog.sparkline.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Create Sparklines. The type (Line, Column, Win/Loss) is the menu item that opened it.

dialog.comment.note: U:grid/insert: gridcraft opens a dialog for the comment text (Excel shows a card in the cell); it starts with the cell's existing comment.

dialog.recommendedPivotTables.title: Recommended PivotTables
dialog.recommendedPivotTables.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Recommended PivotTables over gridcraft's `suggestions`: the layouts that suit the data in a list, a preview of the one picked (drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/recommendedPivotTables.tsx). Blank PivotTable and Change Source Data are Create PivotTable's.

dialog.createPivotChart.title: Create PivotChart
dialog.createPivotChart.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Create PivotChart (Table/Range, New Worksheet or Existing Worksheet with its Location); the answer is a blank PivotTable and its chart.

fields.label: Choose where you want the PivotTable report and PivotChart to be placed

dialog.customCombo.title: Insert Chart
dialog.customCombo.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Custom Combination (a chart type and a Secondary Axis box for each series, with a preview), drawn by src/apps/grid/dialogs/customCombo.tsx. Not checked against upstream.

dialog.signatureSetup.title: Signature Setup
dialog.signatureSetup.note: U:grid/insert: Excel's Signature Setup: the suggested signer, title and e-mail, instructions for the signer, whether the signer may add comments and whether the sign date shows. Not checked against upstream.

fields.label: Allow the signer to add comments in the Sign dialog
Show sign date in signature line
